messages:
Maria S: Async standup — quick check-in (audits / KMS / IAM / vuln queue)
Maria S: Yesterday: ran the quarterly audit sweep in staging (audit.yaml -> CIS checks), caught two DB IAM policies with wildcard actions. Opened PR #482 to tighten them.
Maria S: Blocker: need an approver for cross-account assume-role changes (ops account). Pinged Dan.
Dan R: On it — review queue now. Will check PR #482 and the cross-account role policy before EOD.
Dan R: FYI I also saw an alert from sec-bot about an expired key in prod (kms key alias/ri-prod-rotate).
sec-bot: [automated] KMS key alias/ri-prod-rotate: scheduled rotation missed window. See runbook: https://internal/reboot/kms-rotation
Lee T: I took the prod KMS rotation ticket. Found the rotate script hit a permissions error when calling PutKeyRotationStatus.
Lee T: Error snippet: ```AWS error: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/rotator-role is not authorized to perform: kms:PutKeyRotationStatus on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef12```
Lee T: Plan: add kms:PutKeyRotationStatus to rotator-role in staging, test, then promote. Will coordinate with Dan for IAM change.
Sam K: On vuln remediation: patched nginx on canary, ran e2e smoke, looks good. I still need time to backport the OpenSSL fix to our legacy image — blocked by test flakiness on nightly.
Maria S: For compliance docs — I updated the evidence tracker with the audit run output (s3://redwood-audits/2026/q1). Please add any manual signoffs.
Dan R: @Maria S thanks. I'll be approver for the IAM PR once I verify the cross-account role change (need to ensure no EC2 instance profiles lose access).
Dan R: Quick ask — @Lee T can you paste the terraform snippet you plan to apply? Want to run a quick drift check.
Lee T: snippet: ```resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "rotator_put_rotation" { role = "rotator-role" policy = jsonencode({ Version = "2012-10-17" Statement = [{ Action = ["kms:PutKeyRotationStatus"], Effect = "Allow", Resource = "*" }] }) }```
Lee T: I'll scope Resource tighter after initial test.
Sam K: If anyone's free later, can you help me debug the nightly tests? The failure is in the cert generation step.
Maria S: I can pair for 30 mins at 11:30 PT.
Dan R: I can help after 1pm PT.
sec-bot: [reminder] Compliance doc submission deadline in 4 days.
Maria S: Today: finish PR #482 review, approve rotator-role test in staging, coordinate with Sam on test flakiness.
Lee T: Today: apply temporary rotator policy to staging, run rotation, validate, then tighten resource ARNs.
Sam K: Today: keep investigating nightly cert failure, open a separate thread if we need infra changes.
Dan R: Today: review PRs, run IAM drift checks, approve cross-account change if safe.
Maria S: Quick note — if anyone modifies IAM in prod this week, ping #eng-oncall and me. We should avoid simultaneous changes during the compliance window. :warning:
Sam K: noted :thumbsup:
Maria S: Thanks everyone — add short replies here if anything changes.
